Advertising Standards

Health and wellness

Last updated: March 3, 2026

Policy details

Ads for weight loss products and services must be targeted to people aged 18 or over, and must not promise results within a set timeframe.

Ads must not shame a person's appearance or body parts, and must not show close-up images of pinched fat.

Prohibited claims

  • Claims that a product cures a disease the platform lists as incurable.
  • Results attributed solely to a wearable device.

Exceptions

Fitness and wellbeing services, general food including protein products, non-permanent cosmetics and dental products such as teeth whitening are exempt from the age restriction.
